adm_f_home: 💎 Finance & payments Manage reports, gateways and card transfers here.
adm_f_not_ready: ⚠️ Complete settings, public URL or exchange rate
adm_f_gateways_head: 🏦 Payment gateways Review each method, effective availability and settings. This is not a transaction test or an endorsement. The minimum/maximum below are shared across payment methods and wallet top-ups.
adm_f_accounts_head: 💳 Destination cards Only the last four digits are shown. Enable/disable requires confirmation. Add/edit/delete cards in the secure web panel. Disabling the last active card makes card transfers unavailable.
adm_f_bonus_head: 🎁 Wallet top-up rewards These are extra bot-wallet credits, not bank cashback. The largest matching reward applies. Edit percentage/minimum/cap rules in the secure web panel.
adm_f_web_missing: No public web URL configured; the secure web settings button is unavailable.
adm_f_auto_warning: ⚠️ This setting can approve receipts and credit wallets without human review, including existing pending receipts. A receipt image is not proof of a bank deposit. Immediate approval uses amount/history/risk checks; timed approval is a separate policy. Trusted customers can be approved independently under existing policy. Apply only if you accept this risk.
adm_f_changed: The setting changed after preview. Generate a fresh preview.
adm_f_invalid_or_not_ready: Invalid value/combination or incomplete provider prerequisites. Minimum cannot exceed maximum. Auto-approval needs a positive amount cap; immediate approval needs at least one reviewed payment in history.
